A '''Maxillipede shuttle''', overseen by the [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] [[Kraken/Legends|Kraken]], was used to transport [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] from [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]] to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|intercepted]] the shuttle and rescued Tup before Kraken's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] could leave Ringo Vinda.<ref name="The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>
